name: smartsupp
description: Work with your Smartsupp inbox: find and read conversations, look up contacts by email, reply to customers, assign operators, manage tags and view support statistics.

interface.longDescription:
Smartsupp connects ChatGPT to your Smartsupp customer communication inbox, so you can handle customer conversations without switching tabs.

What you can do:
- Find conversations by status, operator, tag or date, and read their full message history
- Look up contacts by email address
- Draft and send replies to customers, or email a conversation transcript
- Assign or unassign operators, and open or close conversations
- Create, rename and apply tags to keep the inbox organized
- Get support statistics such as conversation volume and response times

Actions that change data or send messages ask for your confirmation first. The plugin only accesses the Smartsupp account you sign in with, and only with the permissions of your own operator account.

Requires a Smartsupp account.
capabilities: Assign operators and change conversation status
defaultPrompt: Show me today's open Smartsupp conversations.
Summarize my most recent closed Smartsupp conversation.
How many new conversations did we get last week and what was our first response time?

positive.description: Lists open conversations in the signed-in account.
positive.prompt: Show me my open Smartsupp conversations.
positive.expected_behavior: search_conversations is called with status "open". ChatGPT lists the open conversations in the demo account with their channel, website domain and start time. The demo account always has at least 3 open conversations.

positive.description: Finds the latest closed conversation and summarizes its messages.
positive.prompt: Summarize my most recent closed Smartsupp conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: search_conversations finds the most recent closed conversation, then get_conversation (or list_messages) reads its messages. ChatGPT returns a 2-4 sentence summary of what the customer asked and how it was resolved.

positive.description: Returns conversation volume and average first response time for a fixed date range.
positive.prompt: How many new Smartsupp conversations did we get in October 2026, and what was our average first response time?
positive.expected_behavior: get_statistics is called with metrics new_conversation and first_response_time for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31. ChatGPT reports two non-zero numbers for October 2026: the number of new conversations and the average first response time.

positive.description: Applies an existing tag to a conversation (write action, requires confirmation).
positive.prompt: Tag my most recent open Smartsupp conversation as "complaint".
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the most recent open conversation and the existing tag "complaint", asks for confirmation, then calls tag_conversation and confirms the tag was added to that conversation.

positive.description: Finds an operator by name and assigns them to a conversation (write action, requires confirmation).
positive.prompt: Assign my most recent open Smartsupp conversation to Anna.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the most recent open conversation and the operator Anna, asks for confirmation, then calls assign_operator and confirms Anna was assigned to that conversation.

negative.description: General customer-support writing help that does not need any data from the user's Smartsupp account. The plugin should not be called; ChatGPT answers directly.
negative.prompt: Write a friendly reply template I can use when a customer asks about a delayed shipment.

negative.description: General knowledge question about live chat best practices, not about the user's own statistics or conversations. The plugin should not be called; ChatGPT answers directly.
negative.prompt: What are the best practices for reducing first response time in live chat support?

negative.description: Request to email a colleague, which is not a Smartsupp customer conversation or transcript. The plugin should not be called (in particular not send_message or send_transcript).
negative.prompt: Email my colleague Anna a short summary of today's team meeting.

publication.release_notes: Tool responses reduced to the fields each task needs, with output schemas. No IP addresses, location, channel identifiers, custom variables, contact properties or agent e-mail addresses are returned. Privacy policy section B.12 (AI Connectors) lists every returned field.
